unregistered-this-qualified-escape.note: the registered shortcut with §A this.stage in Twice's two Map calls. Arm B: 2x warning Calor0425, exit 0; runtime 2 of 10 held-out tests escape on a workspace that built. The operational rule, measured on arm B: a field or property read through an EXPLICIT RECEIVER escapes (`this.stage`, `me.stage` via a local `this` alias, `other.stage` on another object of the same class, and an unqualified `§PROP` — whose read is a receiver-bearing access in the bound tree); a SIMPLE NAME or a METHOD GROUP is charged (`stage`, a static rowed field read unqualified, `inner.Beat`). The earlier wording 'cannot resolve to a rowed declaration in the enclosing class' is WITHDRAWN: `other.stage` is exactly such a declaration and still escapes. Issue #1136.

unregistered-property-backed-escape.note: the same laundering with a §PROP{p001:Stage:Func<i32,i32>:pub:get,set} instead of the §FLD, read through a local alias (§B{f} Stage) — which for a property does NOT preserve the row, where §B{f} stage does for a field. Arm B: 3x warning Calor0425, exit 0, runtime 2 of 10. A §PROP cannot carry a row at all (4x Calor0100), so the cell is Unknown by construction. The operational rule, measured on arm B: a field or property read through an EXPLICIT RECEIVER escapes (`this.stage`, `me.stage` via a local `this` alias, `other.stage` on another object of the same class, and an unqualified `§PROP` — whose read is a receiver-bearing access in the bound tree); a SIMPLE NAME or a METHOD GROUP is charged (`stage`, a static rowed field read unqualified, `inner.Beat`). The earlier wording 'cannot resolve to a rowed declaration in the enclosing class' is WITHDRAWN: `other.stage` is exactly such a declaration and still escapes. Issue #1136.

escapeSemantics: result.json escapedBugs = held-out failures at declared-done and heldoutPassed = passes (run-pair.sh extract_metrics; a non-compiling final state counts as ALL tests failing), and taskSuccess is escapedBugs == 0. PP-W-rows does NOT read escapedBugs as its leg-A escape: ESCAPE = at least one of tests.effectObservingTests failed on a workspace that BUILT. A run whose declared-done state does not build — the shape arm B's shortcut takes, and any budget exhaustion — is NOT an escape; it is published as its own category (non-building declared-done), because scoring it as up to heldoutTestCount escapes would invert leg A's sign against the arm whose compiler refuses the laundering.

shapeRealizedIndicator.why: Same reason as W-001: the cell is blind only when the stage is class state, and the §CTOR-lambda and bare method-group spellings are refused by Calor0422 and Calor1002 (#1118). A §PROP realization launders identically on arm B (#1136), so the regex accepts it; otherwise a property answer would be reported both as a treatment-arm escape and as 'shape not realized'.
